# STD-TEC-NXT-002: Next.js Error Handling and Logging Standards

> This document defines the error handling standards for Next.js applications within enterprise environments. These standards ensure consistent, user-friendly error handling practices across all frontend applications with proper client-side and server-side error management, logging, monitoring, and recovery strategies.

[standards/technology/nextjs/STD-TEC-NXT-002-error-handling-logging.md#10-overview]

## 1.0 Overview

This document defines the error handling standards for Next.js applications within enterprise environments. These standards ensure consistent, user-friendly error handling practices across all frontend applications.
page_texts.6:
[standards/technology/nextjs/STD-TEC-NXT-002-error-handling-logging.md#21-general-principles]

### 2.1 General Principles

- Fail gracefully - errors should never crash the entire application
- Provide meaningful error messages to users
- Log detailed error information for debugging (not exposed to users)
- Handle errors at the appropriate level of abstraction
- Ensure errors don't leave the UI in an inconsistent state
- Use appropriate error categorization
page_texts.12:
[standards/technology/nextjs/STD-TEC-NXT-002-error-handling-logging.md#34-navigation-errors]

### 3.4 Navigation Errors

- Handle navigation errors gracefully
- Provide clear feedback when routes don't exist or aren't accessible
- Implement navigation guards for protected routes
page_texts.20:
[standards/technology/nextjs/STD-TEC-NXT-002-error-handling-logging.md#53-layout-error-handling]

### 5.3 Layout Error Handling

Use error.tsx files within layout boundaries to handle errors at the layout level.
page_texts.24:
[standards/technology/nextjs/STD-TEC-NXT-002-error-handling-logging.md#63-error-monitoring]

### 6.3 Error Monitoring

- Integrate with monitoring services like Sentry, LogRocket, or New Relic
- Configure proper error grouping and filtering
- Set up alerts for critical errors
page_texts.26:
[standards/technology/nextjs/STD-TEC-NXT-002-error-handling-logging.md#71-user-facing-error-messages]

### 7.1 User-Facing Error Messages

- Use clear and concise error messages
- Avoid technical jargon in user-facing messages
- Provide actionable next steps when possible
- Consider localization for error messages
page_texts.28:
[standards/technology/nextjs/STD-TEC-NXT-002-error-handling-logging.md#73-toast-notifications]

### 7.3 Toast Notifications

- Use toast notifications for transient errors
- Keep notifications concise and actionable
- Position notifications to not disrupt the user experience
page_texts.31:
[standards/technology/nextjs/STD-TEC-NXT-002-error-handling-logging.md#82-fallback-ui]

### 8.2 Fallback UI

- Design fallback UI for components that might fail
- Provide useful information in the fallback UI
- Allow users to recover or navigate away
page_texts.32:
[standards/technology/nextjs/STD-TEC-NXT-002-error-handling-logging.md#83-graceful-degradation]

### 8.3 Graceful Degradation

- Implement feature detection and progressive enhancement
- Provide alternative functionality when features fail
- Ensure core functionality remains accessible
